nodes.label: Favicon (Shajgoj Brand Mark)
nodes.description: High-res favicon: two offset half-ring arcs (pink gradient on top, gold gradient on bottom) interlocking around a central circle to form a stylized S monogram on a transparent background.

nodes.label: Stylized S Monogram Logo
nodes.rationale: Two horizontally offset semicircular rings suggest the letter S for Shajgoj while also reading as a ring/circle, a compact mark suitable for favicon and small UI sizes.

nodes.label: Pink-Gold Brand Gradient Palette
nodes.rationale: Soft pink-to-rose and bronze-to-light-gold gradients convey a beauty/cosmetics, premium feel consistent with a beauty e-commerce brand.
